hero.heading: Engineering the systems ambitious companies run on.
hero.lede: DivSphere designs, builds, and operates software, cloud, and data infrastructure for teams who need a technology partner that ships — not just advises. From a single product to enterprise-wide transformation.

capabilitiesIntro.heading: Seven capabilities, one delivery team.
capabilitiesIntro.lede: Every engagement draws on the same bench of engineers, architects, and consultants — so a cloud migration and the analytics layer on top of it come from one accountable team.

processSteps.title: Discover
processSteps.body: Stakeholder interviews, technical audit, and a scoped delivery plan.

processSteps.title: Design
processSteps.body: Architecture, UX, and data models validated before a line of production code is written.

processSteps.title: Build
processSteps.body: Iterative delivery in two-week cycles, with a working build in your hands from sprint one.

processSteps.title: Deploy
processSteps.body: Staged rollout, load testing, and security review ahead of go-live.

processSteps.title: Support
processSteps.body: SLA-backed monitoring, on-call support, and a roadmap for what's next.

ctaBand.heading: Have a system that needs building — or fixing?
ctaBand.body: Tell us where it's breaking down. We'll respond within one business day with next steps.

seo.description: Software, cloud, data, and security engineering for companies in Qatar and the Gulf. Custom apps, ERP, AI, and cybersecurity from one delivery team.
